summary: Masonglory Ltd, a Hong Kong-incorporated construction specialty trade contractor listed on the NYSE under a US-style foreign private issuer registration, filed a Form 6-K disclosing that Mr. Tsz Tun Tse resigned as Chief Executive Officer and Director effective September 24, 2026. Mr. Tse cited personal reasons and no disagreement with the Company. On the same date, the Board approved re-designating Mr. Jinyu Xie as CEO and co-chairman of the board. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or regulatory terms were disclosed; the abrupt CEO and board-level change is itself the event. Watch for follow-on governance disclosures or strategic shifts under new leadership.
